measure.sourceTitle: How much do hostels cost around the world? Hostel Price Index for 2023 - Price of Travel
measure.evidenceText: Price of Travel's Hostel Index lists London, England, Clink261, at $35.35 per night. The methodology states the price is per night including taxes and fees for one person in a shared dorm room, using the average of a Thursday and Friday night in mid April 2023.
measure.referencePeriod: Average Thursday and Friday night in mid-April 2023; article dated 2023-01-16.
measure.searchQuery: site:priceoftravel.com/how-much-do-hostels-cost-around-the-world London England Hostel Index dorm bed price
measure.reason: Found as a source-defined one-person shared-dorm index observation; no conversion to two travellers is performed here.
